rongmei.title: Kandi khou rianra mei le thiammei

lines: 1. Kandi khou rianra mei le thiammei rui padik the,
Lungning dingmei makna ruantat bammei nun
Nthuan panti tabui guang puni cho ‘niu thaimak,
‘Niu hei poubaomei hukhou rui maengdu tat khuan the.
Poubaomei zailou o
Nangbang paap zei khou kei louna thau ngam mak
Pou rui nzianna ata zaithaulou o,
Kandi champan rui ata nkhalou ngam mak.
2. Kandi tuang neila rui ata phungtat bam khuan e.
Ringmei chaengluan khou rui ata duang maanlou;
Pou rui nzianna kaomei khuan ai chudat mak khe,
Pou khuan tei nking o maengduna tatmei nunle.
3. Tingzin keithe aniu tabui thang tat bam tucho?
Nkhammei tingzin kaengkhuan tei chuguang e;
Simei taan guai pat louna ngalan guangdat dikho
Zingmei lim ruina aniu ta dinghaeng guang puthe.
4. Paap duidai hei kanpatna aniu kai tang dikho;
Pap zeilaa khou banthaina ding bammei nun,
Ngalan guangtho tuna khuanzaengna pou rui kau the.
Ruansaeng lang khe, neimik keirina zing ri puni.
